reply_text:
*CRITICAL*
None.

*INFORMATIONAL*
1. `src/excerpt.js:6–8` — Short text is truncated and always gets an ellipsis: `excerpt('hello world', 20)` returns `'hello…'`; empty input returns `'…'`.
   *Fix:* Return text unchanged when its length is at most the limit, per the README; test short, exact-limit, and empty inputs.

2. `src/words.js:2–3` — A word boundary exactly at the limit is excluded: `excerpt('one two three', 7)` returns `'one…'` instead of `'one two…'`.
   *Fix:* Include the boundary at index `limit`; update `test/words.test.js`’s “finds the last space at or before the limit,” which currently asserts the incorrect result.

3. `src/plain.js:3` — Removing every underscore destroys literal content: `[release_notes](https://example.com)` becomes `releasenotes`.
   *Fix:* Strip Markdown formatting contextually, preserving literal underscores and code contents; add regression tests.

4. `src/card.js:2` — The card path still returns the full Markdown body; neither `toPlain` nor `excerpt` is called outside tests. The advertised card previews never appear.
   *Fix:* Wire `toPlain` → `excerpt` into card construction with the intended preview limit; add a card integration test.

All four existing tests pass. No files changed.
